waterfall_V3R_to_V3F.step: 0 V3-R as published (43 mAh, USB-C tab, unlit always-on display)
1 D-1: 70 mAh pack in the capsule (4.5 mm), R_LIM 12 ohm, RISET 10.2 kohm (S1 D-8)
2 D-4: two flush contacts + isolated USB-C head; no strap tab
3a D-2 hardware: front light designed in (film above the panel, Q11 driver; face still always on)
3b D-2 firmware: night blank after 30 min without light
4 alerts: 8 mm low-current ERM in a board cut-out
5 input: sealed side button (+ ship wake via a BAV70M pair) + gated double tap
6 safety floor: hardware PV-charge inhibit (O-2) reserved on the board
7 5 ATM load path (two glasses, 0.70 mm window on a rigid bond, stainless rib + 6 posts, PV strips 2.30 mm), glass capsule top, band quick release
8 0201 passives where the project has the part = V3-F
